tiles.title: Grip socks
tiles.text: Bring a clean pair to change into. No bare feet in the studio.

tiles.title: What to wear
tiles.text: Form-fitting clothes. Leggings or long pants work best for full range of motion.

tiles.title: No metal or zippers
tiles.text: Skip zippers, buttons, watches, and jewelry that can scratch the equipment.

tiles.title: Skip the lotion
tiles.text: Perfume, makeup and lotions can stain the upholstery.

faqs.question: What's your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Must cancel at least 24 hours before your session.

faqs.question: I've never done Pilates. Is that okay?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every new client starts with a $40 First Session to learn the essentials before joining open-level sessions.

faqs.question: How many people are in a class?
faqs.answer: Never more than three, so you always get real attention from your instructor.

faqs.question: I have an injury. Can I still come?
faqs.answer: Please let Lynn know about any injuries or physical concerns. She will help determine whether group or private sessions are the best fit.

faqs.question: Where do I park?
faqs.answer: The studio is at 23 Portside Drive in Holbrook, directly off Sunrise Hwy behind the Stop & Shop shopping center, with easy parking.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: With Venmo, through Vagaro or cash.
